mapper.insert: insert into pay_record (pay_id, order_id, record_no, content, status, channel_response, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{payId}, #{orderId}, #{recordNo}, #{content}, #{status}, #{channelResponse}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select pr.id, pr.order_id, pr.record_no, pr.content, pr.status, pr.channel_response, p.amount, p.method as pay_method, o.order_no, pr.create_time from pay_record pr left join pay p on p.id = pr.pay_id left join `order` o on o.id = pr.order_id where o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} and p.method = 2 order by pr.create_time desc
select id, pay_id, order_id, record_no, content, status, channel_response, create_time from pay_record where order_id = #{orderId} order by create_time desc
